items.where: p · What is IV vitamin therapy?
items.original: IV vitamin therapy delivers fluids and essential nutrients directly into the bloodstream for maximum absorption. Up to 85% of a vitamin pill can be lost to digestion; an IV delivers close to 100%. It helps combat dehydration, boost energy, support immunity and enhance overall wellness.
